description: Versioned, primary-source-identified seeds for the daily generative-foundations classic lane.

papers.title: Auto-Encoding Variational Bayes
papers.curation_summary: Introduces the reparameterized variational lower-bound estimator that made scalable gradient-based learning of latent-variable generative models practical.

papers.title: Generative Adversarial Nets
papers.curation_summary: Frames generative learning as a minimax game between a generator and a discriminator, establishing the modern adversarial generation paradigm.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
papers.curation_summary: Establishes a high-quality diffusion generative model through denoising score matching and a weighted variational objective.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models
papers.curation_summary: Shows that the DDPM training objective admits non-Markovian implicit samplers, enabling much faster deterministic or stochastic generation.

papers.title: Score-Based Generative Modeling through Stochastic Differential Equations
papers.curation_summary: Unifies score-based and diffusion models with forward and reverse-time SDEs, predictor-corrector sampling, and an equivalent probability-flow ODE.

papers.title: Flow Straight and Fast: Learning to Generate and Transfer Data with Rectified Flow
papers.curation_summary: Introduces rectified flow, which learns ODE transports along increasingly straight paths to reduce discretization error and accelerate sampling.

papers.title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
papers.curation_summary: Introduces simulation-free conditional vector-field regression for continuous normalizing flows and connects diffusion paths with optimal-transport paths.

papers.title: Consistency Models
papers.curation_summary: Introduces models that map points on a probability-flow trajectory to a consistent endpoint, enabling one-step or few-step generation.
